assessments.reasoning: Authenticity follows from publisher_live at creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode.txt. Integrity follows from the matching scoped body digest and matching [5884,6024) digest for section 4(a). Relevance comes from that clause naming both trademark and patent rights. Interpretation follows from its express exclusion of waiver, abandonment, surrender, licensing and any other effect by this document. Applicability follows from “held by Affirmer” in 4(a) and the Statement of Purpose identifying who applies CC0 to a Work. The contradiction check found that sections 2 and 3 each concern the Affirmer's Copyright and Related Rights, section 1(iv) expressly preserves the 4(a) limitation, and section 4(c) addresses third-party clearance separately.

limitations: The finding concerns the instrument's effect on rights held by the Affirmer. Ownership, separate grants, defenses and third-party clearance require separate evidence.
reasoning: When an Affirmer applies CC0 to a Work, section 4(a) expressly preserves trademark and patent rights held by that Affirmer. Its wording covers both surrender through the waiver and licensing through the fallback.
